formato: CourseGradingConfig.exam_script (apps/practice/conversa/exame.py, validar_guiao); carregar com manage.py carregar_exame_curso

perguntas.pergunta: Hello, {nome}. Welcome to your speaking exam. What's your surname, and how do you spell it?
perguntas.simples: What's your surname? Spell it, please.
Do you have brothers and sisters? Do you have children?

perguntas.pergunta: Now tell me about your day. What time do you get up?
perguntas.simples: What time do you get up? Six? Seven?

perguntas.pergunta: How do you go to work?
What do you usually do at the weekend?
perguntas.simples: On Saturday, what do you do?

perguntas.pergunta: Think of a person in your family or a friend. What does he or she do every day?
perguntas.simples: Your mother, your brother, your friend: what time does he or she get up?

notas: After the family question, ask one follow-up: What's his or her name? How old is he or she?
After the question about another person, ask: Does he or she work on Saturdays?
If the student does not work (student, unemployed, retired), accept it and ask what they do every day.
If the student prefers not to talk about their family, accept it and ask about a friend.
Use only language from units 1 to 5 (be, present simple, have/has, questions with do/does): no past, no can.

tarefa.80-100: Answers every question and solves the situation without help.
tarefa.60-79: Answers most questions and solves the situation, with some repetition.
tarefa.40-59: Answers about half of the questions; the situation is left half done.
tarefa.0-39: Answers few questions, or answers in Portuguese.

gramatica.80-100: be, present simple (with he/she), have/has and questions almost always correct.
gramatica.60-79: Frequent mistakes with the third person or articles, but the sentences are understood.
gramatica.40-59: Many mistakes; some sentences are not understood.

vocabulario.80-100: Uses the words of units 1-5 with ease and explains what they cannot say.
vocabulario.60-79: Enough words for the tasks; some pauses to find words.
vocabulario.40-59: Basic words are missing (times, family, jobs).
vocabulario.0-39: Very few words, or Portuguese words.

fluencia.80-100: Short sentences one after another, with few long pauses.
fluencia.60-79: Frequent pauses, but keeps talking; uses Let me think.
fluencia.40-59: Long pauses and very short sentences.

nao_baixa: one Portuguese word followed by an explanation in English
